summary.list: {{shown}} specs from #{{from}} of {{matched}} matching ({{total}} in the project): {{counts}}.
summary.list_none: No spec of {{project}} matches these filters.
summary.deleted: Moved {{ref}} to Recently deleted; restore brings it back.
summary.restore_live: {{ref}} was not deleted; nothing to restore.
summary.trash: {{count}} recently deleted specs; each is purged after {{days}} days.
summary.bulk.trash: Moved {{changed}} specs to Recently deleted; {{skipped}} skipped.
summary.bulk.merge: Merged {{count}} specs into {{target}}; the merged specs are in Recently deleted.
summary.triaged_next: Next: the launch offer puts them on rails and starts them in one call (no rails setup).
summary.addendum_added: Added addendum {{ref}} to {{spec}}; it rides into the next launch.
summary.async.ai_edit.pending: The AI edit of {{spec}} is running (request {{request}}).
summary.async.ai_edit.done: The AI proposed a new description for {{spec}}; it is not applied yet.
summary.async.refine.failed: Adding the Contract Layer to {{spec}} failed: {{error}}
hint.pending: Still running. get(options.request: "{{request}}") waits for the result.
hint.ai_edit_apply: Show the proposal to the person; apply it with specrails_specs(update, patch.body).
confirm.create: The spec agent writes a new spec of {{ref}} from the request.
confirm.refine: AI adds the Contract Layer to {{ref}}.
confirm.ai_edit: AI proposes a new description for {{ref}} (not applied).
confirm.merge: Folds {{count}} specs into {{target}} and moves them to Recently deleted: {{titles}}.
confirm.purge: Deletes {{count}} specs permanently, with their attachments: {{titles}}.
error.rail_running: Rail {{rail}} is running; its specs change after the run.
error.request_unknown: No AI request {{request}} in the last 15 minutes.
error.file_too_large: Attachments sent through MCP are at most {{max}} MB.
error.verbatim_body: mode verbatim needs body: the spec text as written.
warning.cursor_stale: The backlog changed since the previous page; items may repeat or be skipped.
warning.section_failed: The {{section}} section could not be read: {{error}}
choice.launch: Starts a run on a rail (AI work).
choice.launch_addenda: Starts a run that includes the open addenda.
choice.promote: The spec becomes ready to launch.
choice.refine: An agent adds acceptance criteria (AI work).
choice.review: Opens the delivery for your decision.
choice.iterate: Records a change the next run must make.
choice.reopen: Puts the spec back on the board.
choice.smash: An agent splits it into smaller specs (AI work).
choice.launch_parallel: Starts one run per spec in parallel (AI work).
